answer.rationale: Roll out shortened, simplified onboarding: it has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention, supporting durable qualified revenue from new SMB demand. Do not broadly counter the competitor with promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment showed a 12% 30-day retention decline and explicitly found the acquisition lift unsustainable. This will not directly eliminate churn among existing price-sensitive accounts, so that uncertainty remains material.
